classes.name: Slayer
classes.gauge:
Vital Points (3 strikes)

Each skill will cause 1 of the following debuffs

Head vital point -> increase the damage done by the player that stacks 3x
Body vital point -> decrease def that stacks 3x

After the 3 stacks on the 3 points reached, consume all 9 stacks to do a blood damage based on target max HP
Leg vital point -> cause small slow that stacks 3x

classes.name: Light Storm
classes.gauge:
Charges: Each skill can generate positive or negative charges

While they are even -> Increase stagger damage

When positive is Higher -> Increase lightning damage and penetration

When negative is Higher -> Increase crit chance and damage and stagger damage

If positive or negative reaches 100% and the other 0% -> overchager is enabled (buffs needs to be decided) and the bar is back to 50/50 after the duration
